plans.philosophy: FIX THE KNOWN. The confirmed causes C1-C9 are not hypotheses awaiting a calibration; four of them are breaches of rules this house adopted on 13-Jul-2026 and never wired to a script, and the fifth is a construction that never cleared the promotion rule it was required to clear. The plan therefore sorts every change into four bins and treats them differently. (i) ALREADY-ADOPTED, UNENFORCED RULES — the r2 sliding schedule with WACC_TERM < WACC_EXP as a hard ASSERT (engine/Standing_Research_Protocol.md:314), CDS basis PRIMARY (:327), terminal ERP never held flat into perpetuity (:334), the Kd-integrity gate 'All three raise. The build fails' (:338-345), NCI deducted at fair value never at book (:383-387), L-048/L-055 (Lessons_Register.md:552, :622) — these are ENFORCED NOW as asserts in engine/research_protocol.py and CI scripts, because enforcing a rule adds no free parameter: PHDC (phdc_study/valuation_v2.py:54-74, one scalar wacc for pv and tv) and TMGH (tmgh_study/valuation.py:41-108, one scalar for ten explicit years, a 14-year annuity and a perpetuity) are non-conforming deliverables under text that says 'is a QC FAIL' (:348), and both QC gates passed them because nothing in scripts/ reads a rate path. (ii) CONSTRUCTIONS THAT NEVER CLEARED THE BAR — the typed lens weights (phdc valuation_v2.py:151-155 0.45/0.15/0.20/0.20; amoc compute.py:533; arcc compute.py:769-773, all 'study judgement', no out-of-sample test anywhere in scripts/ or engine/) — are REMOVED NOW, because removal of an unpromoted parameter is what the promotion rule already demands; the DCF or class primary is the central and the other lenses become a labelled range. (iii) ARITHMETIC IDENTITIES — Fisher coherence between a nominal rate and a nominal growth, terminal reinvestment on one capital basis, a sensitivity grid that reproduces its own base (L-062) — are ASSERTED NOW; an identity is not a parameter. (iv) GENUINELY NEW PARAMETERS — lambda-scaling of the country premium, beta shrinkage, Dimson term selection, correction strength other than the stated 0.5, any re-admitted blend — are DEFERRED to the valuation-layer walk-forward, which is built in parallel as the standing MONITOR, not as a precondition, and are promoted only when it says so under LONO and era split. Every bin-(i)-(iii) change ships with a PRE-REGISTERED REVERT CONDITION that the monitor grades, so 'ship now' is accountable, not unaccountable. Price enters nowhere except the monitor's score and the two-sided gap gate ([R-LENS-01]: price grades, never feeds). The digest already states the meta-rule this plan applies: 'A GATE WITH NO RELEASE IS A STALL', and its converse — a rule with no gate is a wish — is the whole diagnosis of C9.
plans.thesis: This plan ends the pessimism without deferring to price because the gap on four of the five calibrated names is manufactured by rule breaches and unpromoted constructions whose correction is fully specified by the house's own text and whose effect is already computed in the repository, so applying them requires no number chosen by looking at the market. TMGH's own committed gap_review_calcs.json moves its capacity case 53.05 -> 89.47 (-8.5% vs 97.80) on two corrections at the UNCHANGED 35.79% rate (SALES_FADE 0.85 nominal restated real; NCI at the filed 20.98% profit share instead of 45.21% book), and the r2 glide the protocol already mandates for 'every new Egyptian study' (SRP:304) is worth a further +33% to +95% on that case on the study's own valuation.discounted(); PHDC's DCF lens already sits at 14.86 against 15.20 and its -28% is 96% the three non-DCF lenses (gap_review_calcs.json lens_gap_contrib: NEP -2.01, Book -1.30, Rel -0.81, DCF -0.15), so retiring the typed blend and re-specifying NEP at E/(Ke-pi) moves it to within a few per cent before any rate change — and the one warning the evidence carries (the glide alone prints +83% on PHDC because its statement layer over-forecasts profit 3x on its own walk-forward record) is handled by fixing statements and rate in ONE pass under a single macro path, with an explicit-horizon convergence assert so the terminal cannot swallow the valuation; AMOC and ARCC are within +7.4%/-2.4% on DCF alone. Everything above is either enforcement of SRP:302-348 and :383-387, removal of a never-tested weight, or an identity — none is a fitted parameter, so the PROMOTION RULE is respected in letter and in substance. What the plan does NOT do is cut the level of the cost of equity to meet the price: the level, lambda, shrinkage and any blend are handed to a valuation-layer walk-forward built in parallel, which grades every shipped change against realised prices out of sample and can revert any of them, and a two-sided gap gate plus a mandatory reverse-DCF table make the process audit its own answer so the principal never has to ask 'check the cost of capital, the revenue, the cost' again. The expected landing is the five names inside roughly ±20% except EGCH, whose residual is a driver judgement that must survive on its statements or fall.

workstreams.title: Statement calibration: from measurement to actuator, symmetric — [R-FCAL-01 amended]
workstreams.problem: C5, C7, C12. [R-FCAL-01] scores per-driver log errors against later statements and nothing else; across ~170 scored cells it changed ONE number in one study (ARCC manufacturing depreciation x1.0298, compute.py:480-487); TMGH's four 'adopted' corrections carried 0.000 log into every projected line (forward_ranges.json correction_applied_log = 0.0) because the two-sigma break reset zeroed them at origin 2025 when the bias merely got WORSE in the same direction; the half-strength 0.5 is stated, never derived (SRP:1508); the method loses to 'freeze last year's profit' at h1 on four of five and under-forecasts revenue in sign on four of five, yet TMGH then built FY2026 contracted sales 38.6% BELOW its own record's central and gross profit below the record's p10, while PHDC built 18% ABOVE its revenue central with a profit line its record says runs 3x high (npat_mi +1.116, 97% of cells). Nothing requires a forward driver to face its own record.
workstreams.change: (a) research_protocol.assert_forward_inside_record(study, walkforward): every year-1 and year-2 forward driver that the name's walk-forward scores must sit inside that record's p10-p90 for the driver, or carry a NAMED mechanism with a PRICED exception in the study's register — symmetric, so PHDC's profit line above its p90 fails exactly as TMGH's gross profit below its p10 does. what_this_does_not_fix: THE LEVEL OF THE COST OF EQUITY. The plan enforces the path (glide, terminal norms) and the basis (CDS central) but does not cut Ke to meet the price: lambda-scaling of the country premium (TMGH 37.15% -> 32.57%), Vasicek/Blume shrinkage, Dimson term selection and any Egypt-specific relative-volatility argument (the same Damodaran file gives 2.66, which would RAISE the premium) are deferred to the monitor. If the monitor's first record is undetermined at n ~ 10 origins per name — likely for a year or more — the level stays where the enforced rules put it, and TMGH may remain materially below price on the recovery cases.

EGCH's ANNA judgement. Margin-as-output, one AN price path and depreciation-once are house-rule fixes and are applied; whether a 264kt AN complex at 50% utilisation earns above its depreciation is a driver judgement the plan does not overrule. Its own arithmetic leaves the central 55-67% below price after the fixes; the plan publishes that with its reverse-DCF (implied 7.75%) rather than forcing it home.

MARKET-WRONG vs METHOD-WRONG cannot be adjudicated by anything in this plan before the monitor has power (n=32, IC -0.14 today; ~783 observations needed for IC 0.10 at 80% power per the 24-Aug backtest). The plan removes the method's KNOWN defects; it does not prove the corrected method is right.

THE OTHER 32 EGX NAMES AND 27 FIRST-BUILDS. WS9 measures them and queues them; nothing rebuilds them. SRP:493's ~27 flat-WACC live DCFs remain live and understated until each is naturally revisited under the campaign's fixed order and hard stop.

DATA THE REPO DOES NOT HOLD: point-in-time EGP sovereign/T-bill/policy-rate history and Damodaran ERP vintages (the monitor drops origins where a vintage is missing — its origin count is bounded by what can be sourced, not by what exists); dividend/total-return series (raw_ohlc has price only); PHDC's cash-flow-statement classification, amortised-cost investment note and land price per sqm; TMGH's subsidiary-level NCI attribution. Each is a STOP-AND-ASK under SIGCM, not an estimate, and each can stall its workstream by days.

THE HALF-STRENGTH CONSTANT and the correction-strength rule. The plan reports sensitivities at 0.25/0.5/1.0 and leaves 0.5 as the stated default; selecting a strength is a monitor promotion, so the statement calibration remains a weak actuator until then — its two new asserts (forward inside record; claims reconcile) are what bite now.

AMOC's walk-forward (five statement years, LIGHT at best) and any name with fewer than five statement years cannot enter the monitor's FULL population; their fair values are graded on the LIGHT proxy only and that proxy is declared, not dressed up.

plans.philosophy: MEASURE FIRST, THEN CHANGE ONLY WHERE THE RECORD SAYS SO, AND ONLY THROUGH THE PROMOTION RULE. The house has a calibration for the statements ([R-FCAL-01]: scores per-driver log error against later filings, Fundamental_Walkforward_Prompt.md §2-§5) and none for the valuation layer — no script anywhere grades a discount rate, a terminal, a lens, a weight, a bridge or a fair value against anything (research_protocol.py's five asserts at lines 226/272/325/425/463 read booleans, beta-record keys, driver coverage and source text; scripts/check_valuation_gap.py:72-82 substring-matches eight heading strings and, on this checkout, prints clean with PHDC at -28.0% and TMGH at -59.8%). That is exactly where the money is: on PHDC the DCF lens sits at 14.86 vs 15.20 and the three accounting lenses carry -4.11 of the -4.26/sh gap (engine/phdc_study/gap_review_calcs.json lens_gap_contrib); on TMGH the flat 35.79% rate plus a -15%/yr NOMINAL fade plus the minority at book carry the gap (gap_review_calcs.json: case_published 53.05 -> case_both_corrections 89.47 at the UNCHANGED rate; implied_rate 23.09%/19.43%). So the plan builds a VALUATION-LAYER WALK-FORWARD — fair value rebuilt at each historical fiscal-year origin from point-in-time inputs, scored as log(FV_t / P_{t+h}) at h = 1, 2, 3 years, on every EGX name with a statement panel (PHDC 10 origins, TMGH 10, EGCH 13, ARCC 7, AMOC LIGHT) and a price-only rate test on the 31 of 37 EG names with >= 10 year-end closes (computed this session from engine/raw_ohlc/EG/*.csv) — BEFORE any level parameter moves. Three classes of change are kept apart and the distinction is written into the protocol: (A) COMPLIANCE and SPECIFICATION fixes, which need no out-of-sample evidence because they apply a rule the house already adopted or remove an internal contradiction (the 13-Jul r2 sliding schedule at Standing_Research_Protocol.md:302-348 that PHDC/TMGH breach; CDS-basis PRIMARY at :327; NCI at value share at :383-387; L-048/L-055 Fisher coherence; the corrections.py schema bug; unopened filings) — these run in parallel with the measurement; (B) LEVEL and DESIGN choices (ERP basis as a level, CRP scaling, terminal ERP norm, glide length, lens form and weights, beta shrinkage, Kd floor), which are PRE-REGISTERED from external principles — never fitted to the gap — and adopted only where the walk-forward shows bias shrinking on held-out names AND both era halves without MAE worsening; (C) ENFORCEMENT — every rule in (A) and every promoted choice in (B) gets an outside script that fails rather than warns, negative-controlled, anchored to a population counted elsewhere [R-ENF-01/04]. Price grades; price never feeds ([R-LENS-01]).
plans.thesis: This plan ends the pessimism because it treats the gap as five different, already-diagnosed defects rather than one 'rate is too high' error, and because it attacks them in the order that costs nothing in evidence first. The principal's attribution — 'the calibration made it worse' — is mechanically wrong and the plan says so: the [R-FCAL-01] runs changed exactly one number in any valuation arithmetic (ARCC manufacturing depreciation x1.0298, engine/arcc_study/compute.py:480-487), while the PHDC/TMGH collapse (15.89 -> 10.94; 147.12 -> 39.33, engine/fv_movement.json) came from replacing a hardcoded 18% WACC (phdc study_numbers.json derived.prior_edition_wacc 0.18; TMGH lenses.sensitivity.wacc_grid '0.1800|capacity' 195.38) with a FLAT crisis-era 26.25% / 35.79% applied to every year and the perpetuity (phdc valuation_v2.py:54-74; tmgh valuation.py:41-96) — in breach of the house's own 13-Jul r2 rule ('WACC_TERM < WACC_EXP is a hard ASSERT', 'Terminal ERP ... never held flat into perpetuity', 'is a QC FAIL', SRP:302-348), a rule that carries no R-id, has zero hits in the digest (grep glide|sliding|WACC_TERM engine/PROJECT_INSTRUCTIONS_01-09-2026.md = 0) and is enforced by no script — and from a lens blend whose weights are typed 'Study judgement' (phdc valuation_v2.py:151-155; amoc compute.py:533; arcc compute.py:769-773) with no test. Applying the house's OWN rules and removing the internal contradictions the house's OWN gap reviews already computed (TMGH fade restated real + minority at profit share -> 89.47 vs 53.05; PHDC NEP at Ke-g -> +0.65/sh; latest balance sheet +0.26/sh; the r2 glide on PHDC's own code -> DCF 14.86 -> 17.4-27.8 depending on how the cash-flow inflation is glided with it) moves both named studies most of the way to the price with the price never touched — measured on the studies' own committed code, which is the opposite of deference. What those fixes cannot settle — whether Egypt's 9.71% Caa1 premium belongs in a terminal rate for ever, whether the rating or CDS basis is right, whether a four-lens blend or a class lens should be the central, whether TMGH's 1.47 Dimson beta should be shrunk — are level choices, and the house has never graded a level: every house Ke (27.45-37.15%) exceeds the maximum rolling 10-year EGX30 price CAGR ever realised (25.1%, median 12.9%, p90 19.6%, 1,245 windows, computed from engine/raw_indices/EG/EGX30.csv), and the only fair-value-vs-price test in the repo is n=32 one-month cells with IC -0.140 and verdict INSUFFICIENT-POWER (engine/value_gap_backtest_EG_20260824.json). The valuation-layer walk-forward is the vintage generator that test lacked; it produces, per origin and per name, the implied cost of equity, the bias of each pre-registered construction, and a LONO/era-stable promotion decision. Nothing about it consumes price as an input: candidate constructions are written down from Fisher, Koller and Damodaran before a single error is computed, and price is the grader. Finally, every rule this plan applies or promotes ships with an outside script that reads the study's committed NUMBERS (rate path, terminal coherence, lens provenance, bridge basis, study-vs-record, gap-review corrections applied-or-declined) and fails — so the principal's three recurring prompts ('check the cost of capital / missing revenue / inflated cost') become CI failures a human never has to ask for.

sequencing: DAY 0-1 — W0 first and alone: sync EGCH to origin/main, fix corrections.py and the schema, freeze the five-name baseline and fv_movement entries. Nothing branches off a checkout that is 61 files behind on one study. Same day: W1 data requests go out (STOP-AND-ASK to the principal for the EGP yield history and Damodaran vintages if they cannot be fetched), and W2's PRE_REGISTRATION is written and committed BEFORE any valuation-layer number exists — its hash is what later proves no candidate was fitted to the gap.

DAY 1-9 — FOUR PARALLEL TRACKS off the clean main. Track A (measurement): W2 scaffold, then PHDC / TMGH / EGCH / ARCC origin builds as four parallel agent-runs, then the price-only rate test and the lever decomposition; blocked on W1 only for the rate-layer levers (all other levers score on data already on disk). Track B (coherence + compliance, class A): W3 macro record and gate, W4 rate-path assert + Kd gate + implied-rate diagnostic, W6 bridge gate — each gate is written against the CURRENT studies first so it has a real red case, then the fix lands. Track C (lens + calibration): W5 spec fixes and PHDC RNAV, W7 reset/strength test, study-vs-record gate, watch-flag script. Track D (enforcement + documents): W8 gate suite, CI workflow, ratchets, both governing documents with the seven new ids, digest rename. DAY 8-12 — PROMOTION: W2 lever decomposition and PROMOTION_DECISIONS written; each class-B candidate adopted or declined on the LONO/era/MAE bar; W4/W5 class-B entries resolved; documents amended with the outcomes (a declined lever is filed as a negative result, like R-NEG-01).

DAY 14-18 — W9 EDITION 2 on the promoted method; STANDARD_VERSION bump; QC gates; publish only on instruction.

DAY 18-21 — book-wide: check_rate_path's live list of flat-WACC EGX studies becomes the campaign's next filter at the EGX hard stop; buffer for W1 data failures (if point-in-time yields are unobtainable, the rate layer is graded on the labelled WDI proxy and the class-B rate levers ship as 'untested' rather than promoted).

CRITICAL PATH: W0 -> W1 -> W2 rate-layer scoring -> promotion -> W9 edition 2 (about 14 days minimum). Everything in Tracks B/C/D is off the critical path and could ship edition 1 by day 10 even if W1 stalls.
acceptance_criteria: INSTRUMENT EXISTS AND IS HONEST: engine/valuation_walkforward/ holds a pre-registration whose commit precedes every score file; >= 4 names, >= 40 origin-cells at h=1 and >= 30 at h=3; the 2025 origin reproduces each published central to 1e-6 before any score; block-bootstrap {2,3} CIs printed for every lever x horizon; the negative control is red; check_valuation_walkforward.py fails on a run that examined zero origins.

PROMOTION DISCIPLINE: every class-B lever adopted shows bias shrinking on >= 3 of 4 held-out names (LONO) AND in both era halves, with MAE not worsening, and appears in PROMOTION_DECISIONS with its numbers; zero levers adopted outside that file; zero parameters anywhere whose only justification is the size of today's gap (grep of every study's four-field register for 'gap', 'price', 'spot' as a justification returns nothing).

OUTCOME ON THE FIVE (measured on committed study_numbers.json, never on the site, and stated as an OUTCOME not a target): median |central/price - 1| across AMOC/ARCC/EGCH/PHDC/TMGH <= 15% after edition 2 (28.0% today, computed this session); four of five inside +/-20%; any name outside carries a named contested judgement published both ways with the market-implied version of that judgement printed beside it (EGCH's ANNA case is the expected exception).

POOLED VALUATION BIAS: the valuation walk-forward's pooled bias at h=2 and h=3 across the four scored names has a block-bootstrap CI that includes zero after promotion, and its sign is not the same on all four names (a same-sign pooled bias on every name is the definition of a house lean); at h=1 the method beats the FV=P_t naive benchmark on MAE or every study prints 'the method has not earned the precision it displays at one year' in those words.

EVERY MACRO-SENSITIVE CONSTANT in PHDC and TMGH is a four-field register entry reading the macro record (today bare literals at bottom_up_model.py:33-35/61/86, valuation_v2.py:28, model.py:31-69 and :103).
what_this_does_not_fix: THE MARKET-WRONG HYPOTHESIS STAYS OPEN. The only fair-value-vs-price test is n=32 one-month cells (IC -0.140, 3M n=0, INSUFFICIENT-POWER; ~783 cells needed for IC 0.10 at 80% power) and the VWF adds at most ~40 origin-cells at h=1 on four names — enough to grade CONSTRUCTIONS against each other, not enough to prove the house is right and the EGX is wrong on any single name. EGCH (28-39x trailing P/E vs peers 4-8x) and TMGH (implied Ke at the sovereign yield) remain genuinely contested; this plan makes those disagreements explicit and dual-framed, it does not resolve them.

SMALL n, OVERLAPPING HORIZONS, TWO REGIME BREAKS. Five names, 7-13 origins each, overlapping 1-3 year windows spanning the 2016 float and the 2022-24 devaluations: effective independent n is close to the origin count, era splits will be thin (the statement runs already report degenerate era tests on AMOC), and the record will not be 'validated' in one pass. Fundamental lessons stay PROVISIONAL under [R-LESSON-01]; a lever that clears the bar on four names has cleared it on four names.

AMOC HAS FIVE STATEMENT YEARS and is LIGHT at best in the VWF; the other 32 EGX names have no statement panels, so the cross-name VWF grows only as the campaign produces panels (one name per campaign step) — the price-only rate test covers 31 names, the full instrument covers four.

POINT-IN-TIME COST-OF-CAPITAL DATA MAY NOT EXIST IN USABLE FORM (EGP yield history, Damodaran vintages, dividends for total return). If W1 fails, the rate layer is graded on a labelled proxy and every rate-level lever ships as 'untested'; the class-A compliance fixes (glide, coherence, bridge) still land because they need no vintage.

THE ONE-SIDED GATE IS THE PRINCIPAL'S INSTRUCTION. W8 proposes a two-sided gate on the evidence that the stated counterweight is false; it does not adopt it without the instruction. Until then an over-optimistic study still gets no automatic audit.

PUBLICATION IS SEPARATE. The site will keep showing AMOC 5.95 / ARCC 54.65 / EGCH 3.64 / PHDC 15.89 / TMGH 147.12 until 'publish' is said; this plan changes committed numbers and gates, not the live page, and the date/standard stamp on fair{} is added only at that publish.

plans.philosophy: REBUILD FROM PRACTICE. Treat the current fundamental method as a failed experiment: a nominal-EGP DCF at a crisis-era rate held flat, blended at typed weights with two run-off lenses, on a bridge invented per study, "calibrated" by an instrument that never grades the answer. Rebuild the study standard around what a disciplined EM buy-side house actually does for Egyptian equities, and make every element of that practice a file that a script can open: (1) value in a stable numeraire — real EGP for domestic businesses, USD for hard-currency businesses — so inflation appears in ONE registered path and cannot be charged in the rate and forgotten in the cash flows; (2) a market-consistent cost of capital whose level is stated as a house convention and then GRADED (CDS-basis country premium as the central, exposure-scaled, real risk-free anchored on the sovereign's real curve, beta shrunk, marginal Kd from facility evidence), with the term structure DERIVED from the inflation path instead of typed as a glide; (3) one central per class — DCF for operating companies, RNAV/SOTP for developers, DDM/RI for banks — with multiples, asset value and normalised earnings published as a labelled RANGE and never averaged; (4) one bridge standard with a balance-sheet classification register and the minority at value share; (5) the study template and the model report re-cut around those four, keeping SIGCM, the ground-up statement build, the four-field register, the depth bar and the external-reader scrub exactly as they are; (6) two calibrations on two clocks — the statement walk-forward [R-FCAL-01] with an actuator that can act, and a NEW valuation-layer walk-forward that strikes the house fair value at past year-ends and grades it against the price that followed, so that "does calibration bring us closer to the actual price" becomes a number with a confidence interval; and (7) gates at the OUTPUT (symmetric gap gate, reverse-DCF table, coherence and bridge asserts, computed-correction-applied-or-blocks) so the process audits its own answer. Salvaged, not patched: SIGCM, assert_ground_up, research_sweep, beta_regression provenance, the walk-forward scoring machinery, the gap-review headings, the ratchet-plus-negative-control pattern, fv_movement. Discarded outright: the nominal flat rate and every per-study glide, per-study macro constants, the weighted four-lens blend and its typed weights, E/Ke with zero growth, historical-cost book as a weighted lens, the circular own-multiple lens, the unruled rating-vs-CDS choice, the sovereign+250bp Kd, per-study bridge conventions, the one-sided gap gate and its false "the house leans optimistic" justification. Price grades the method and never feeds a study [R-LENS-01]; nothing enters the method without an out-of-sample test (PROMOTION RULE); every rule that can be checked is checked from outside by a script that fails [R-ENF-01]; every new rule lands in both governing documents with an id [R-DOC-01].
plans.thesis: The pessimism is manufactured by incoherence, not by a view about the companies, so it can be removed by construction rather than by deferring to price. Verified on the studies' own code this session: PHDC's published DCF is 14.86 at a flat 26.25% with g=12% (engine/phdc_study/valuation_v2.py:54-74; terminal 63% of EV); at the same flat rate with inflation-coherent g=7% it is 10.87, on the house's own written glide to a norm-built 16.26% terminal (Standing_Research_Protocol.md:302-348) it is 27.83 (+83% vs 15.20, terminal 74% of EV), and with the cash flows ALSO put on a single 14.5% path it is 20.21 — the same model prints anything from −28% to +83% depending on which half of a Fisher pair is fixed, which is exactly what a practitioner's real-terms build makes impossible because there is only one inflation path and it sits in numerator and denominator alike. TMGH's published 53.05 (engine/tmgh_study/valuation.py:41-108, 35.79% flat over ten years, a 14-year annuity and a 15% perpetuity) becomes 85.77 on a five-year glide to a norm-built 22.57% terminal, 70.93 on the minority at its filed 20.98% profit share instead of 45.2% of book, 76.04 on a flat-real sales path instead of −15% nominal; at 23.09% flat it equals the price, and the same nominal Ke of 37.15% is 20.0% real at June's 14.3% CPI but 28.2% real if carried into the 7% terminal inflation the house uses on AMOC/ARCC — a rate no EM house charges and none of the house's own rules intended. On AMOC, ARCC and PHDC the DCF sits at +7.4%/−2.4%/−2.2% of price and the published discount is the typed 0.45/0.15/0.20/0.20 blend (PHDC lens_gap_contrib: NEP −2.01, book −1.30, multiple −0.81, DCF −0.15 of −4.26). None of this is a price-fit: the numeraire, the single macro path, the class central with a range, and the bridge register are each what practice does anyway, and every one of them removes a degree of freedom that was being resolved to the punitive side. What remains genuinely open after coherence — the LEVEL of the country premium (CDS 9.41% vs rating 13.94%, λ-scaling, the real-rate convention) — is the one thing practice cannot settle by convention, so this plan settles it the only honest way: a valuation-layer walk-forward that strikes the house fair value at each year-end from 2013 with point-in-time inputs and grades log(FV/P) at 1-3 years against naive benchmarks, LONO across names and split by era, with the candidate constructions pre-registered from practice and selected by that record alone. The plan does not promise every name reaches its price — EGCH's ANNA verdict is a driver judgement and may legitimately stay far below — it promises that when a name does, the reason is printed in a reverse-DCF table beside the answer, and that the same gates that missed six defects at −39% on AMOC now open the delivered record and fail.

JUDGEMENT ON THE PRINCIPAL'S GOAL. The pessimism on four of five names is manufactured by (a) a rule the house adopted and never enforced (flat crisis rate), (b) a construction that never cleared the promotion rule (typed blend), (c) a bridge basis the protocol already forbids (NCI at book, SRP:383-387), and (d) Fisher incoherence (nominal -15% fade, g=12% against ~15% embedded inflation) — none of which needs a walk-forward to justify changing. fix_the_known is the only plan whose ORDER matches that fact: enforce and remove first (TMGH/PHDC movement at day ~7 on already-written text), grade in parallel with pre-registered revert conditions, and print an answer card as the last line of every build so the three recurring prompts become CI lines. measure_first has the best epistemics but puts point-in-time rate data that may not exist on the critical path and ships the five studies twice; its own admission is that if W1 fails the outcome is identical to fix_the_known's, three to eight days later. rebuild re-cuts the template around a numeraire change that its own text concedes would not have moved TMGH (the country premium does not deflate), with the largest blast radius (MODEL_STUDY, workbook gate, ADNOCLS re-issue, three prompts) and the latest first movement (day 12). The house rule already requires a USD/real cross-check, so the numeraire belongs as a mandatory reconciled display, not a rebuild.

WHERE fix_the_known IS WRONG AND THE SYNTHESIS MUST NOT FOLLOW IT: WS5(c) amends the calibration's break-reset rule by assertion (a method change without the held-out test — measure_first W7 does it correctly); the pi>10% book-lens cutoff is a free parameter; 'central = the class primary's central case' would silently promote TMGH's capacity case over the recovery cases and must be dual-framed; the stated landings (TMGH near spot, PHDC +10-25%) must be recorded as falsifiable predictions and kept out of any acceptance criterion; 14 days is optimistic against two STOP-AND-ASK items. THE SKEPTICAL POINT COMMON TO ALL THREE: the valuation walk-forward at ~40 origin-cells on four names cannot locate the country-premium LEVEL (±0.15 log at n≈40), so every plan ends with lambda/basis/real-rate shipping as labelled conventions; the honest expectation is that class-A fixes bring AMOC/ARCC/PHDC/TMGH-capacity inside ±15-20% and leave EGCH and TMGH-recovery contested and dual-framed — and the synthesis must say that a study may legitimately finish 40% below price if its drivers face its record, its rate is the house schedule and the monitor shows no method bias, because a price-shaped acceptance target is the fit-to-gap error in another costume.

Verified in the repo before scoring: SRP:302-348 does carry the r2 sliding schedule as a 'hard ASSERT'/'QC FAIL' rule and it is enforced by no script (research_protocol.py's only asserts are at 226/272/325/425/463; wacc_builder returns warnings; the digest has 0 hits for glide/sliding/WACC_TERM); phdc valuation_v2.py discounts every year and the TV at one scalar and blends at typed 0.45/0.15/0.20/0.20; tmgh valuation.py uses one scalar for ten years, an annuity and a perpetuity and computes NCI at book/proportional only; gap_review_calcs.json holds PHDC lens_gap_contrib NEP −2.006 / book −1.296 / rel −0.806 / DCF −0.151 (sum −4.26), TMGH 53.05 → 89.47 at the unchanged rate, implied 23.09%/19.43%, and new_sales 300,000 vs record 488,368 (−38.6%); tmgh_walkforward/corrections_log.json is empty while study_numbers.json claims four adopted, and corrections.py:150 reads the pre-8fb64664 key shape; check_valuation_gap.py is one-sided (GAP_LIMIT −0.10), substring-matches headings, and prints 'OK — no new violations' on HEAD with 13 unreadable studies; the 24-Aug value-gap backtest is 1M-only, IC −0.140, p=0.45, PARITY; EGCH differs from origin/main by 61 files and the clone is shallow. So all three plans diagnose correctly; they differ on WHEN a level parameter may move relative to the instrument that grades it. measure_first is the only plan whose sequence obeys the PROMOTION RULE without exception: pre-registration hash before any score, an identity check at the 2025 origin, class A/B/C separation with the terminal-ERP level explicitly in class B, a negative control that catches a gap-fitted lever, a sign-heterogeneity criterion on pooled bias, STOP-AND-ASK on vintages with proxies labelled, and rate-level levers shipping 'untested' rather than promoted if data fails. Its holes are real but graftable: no horizon-convergence assert (its own W4 shows PHDC at +83% under the glide), terminal anchors other than the ERP norm not yet named class B, no standing vintage hook, no answer.json. fix_the_known scores lower because it inverts the order — the monitor is 'not the precondition', the terminal anchors (where 75-94% of the rate effect lives) ship as 'stated norms' inside an 'already-adopted rule' with a revert condition that only compares glide-vs-flat, and WS8 publishes the batch to the live site before the first record exists, exceeding the 'publishing is a separate instruction' rule; but it contributes the best accountability devices (revert conditions, assert_horizon_converged, answer.json + answer card, symmetric record assert). rebuild_from_practice scores lowest on rigour because it ships six new constructions (lambda, Vasicek on a covered-name prior, significance-gated Dimson, CRP long-run norm, real-rate convention, numeraire) into re-issued studies before the VWF grades them, under the label 'practice' — the exact channel by which one lean replaces another — and expands scope to re-cutting the closed reference set; but it owns the two best long-horizon instruments (fv_vintages append hook; hash-of-graded-method in the VWF checker), the sharpest quantitative acceptance bar, and the defect-gate map. The synthesis is therefore measure_first's ordering and promotion discipline with fix_the_known's accountability/output-surface machinery and rebuild_from_practice's vintage archive, hash pattern and acceptance bar grafted in, using the six ids already in engine/method_reassessment/PLAN_02-09-2026.md plus three, and leaving the two-sided gate and any publish on the principal's word.

WILL IT MAKE FAIR VALUES REALISTIC? Mechanically, on the studies' own code: AMOC DCF-only +7.4% and ARCC DCF-only -2.4% (removing the blend alone lands both inside ±10%); PHDC rate glide alone → +83% (commit b8bc76ea) — but PHDC's DCF is revenue×cfo_margin (valuation_v2.py:54-58), so the 3x profit over-forecast does NOT flow through the DCF, it flows through the NEP lens the plan deletes; the landing therefore depends almost entirely on the class-B terminal-ERP level and on RNAV, neither of which has a stated construction; TMGH: 89.47 at the flat rate on two class-A corrections, then a glide worth +33-95% → 119-174 vs 97.80, then assert_forward_inside_record pushes new_sales from 300bn toward ≥331bn (p10) → higher still. The programme's own arithmetic says TMGH capacity will land ABOVE the 147.12 the site shows today. The plan sees this ("risks" item 3) but its only guard is a question to the principal. EGCH stays ~-60% by design. Net: three names inside ±10-15%, one likely far ABOVE, one far below — the acceptance "median |gap| ≤15%" is met while the two named studies reverse sign. That is not a process failure, but the plan must be honest that class A on TMGH overshoots and needs the upward review REGARDLESS of the protocol sidedness answer.

DOES IT OVERSHOOT INTO OPTIMISM / CURVE-FIT TO PRICE? Yes, in three places, and the guards do not catch them:
(1) WS6 promotion rule is DIRECTIONALLY TAUTOLOGICAL. Every class-B lever in levers.py (glide vs flat, CDS vs rating, lambda, Blume/Vasicek, minority profit/value share, E/(Ke−g), terminal ERP norm) raises FV. Against a baseline whose bias is negative at every origin (the house has been below price throughout the record), "bias shrinks on ≥3 of 4 names AND both eras" is satisfied by ANY upward lever, and by all of them jointly until the stack overshoots. LONO with 4 names is no protection. This is the CRPS-selection mistake exactly: in-sample score, many candidates, one direction. The plan lacks (a) sequential/joint evaluation with a pre-registered lever ORDER, (b) a stop rule once the stacked bias CI contains zero, (c) a confirmation sample of non-overlapping origins held back from selection (Fundamental_Walkforward_Prompt.md:37 already requires "the rolling record estimates corrections, the non-overlapping origins confirm them"), (d) any multiplicity control for ~12-20 levers on ~36 overlapping cells.
(2) The OUTCOME criterion (median |gap| ≤15%, signed mean within ±15%) sits inside acceptance_criteria while the plan says it is "excluded from any tuning" AND says "Run under a standing /goal against the acceptance criteria". An agent under /goal WILL steer toward it. A criterion that must not be targeted cannot be a stopping condition.
(3) RNAV as class primary for PHDC and TMGH: tmgh_study/inputs.py has 3 sqm/landbank mentions, phdc inputs.py:138 land_bank_sqm_mn=33.0; no land value per sqm anywhere. A gross NAV on 33 mn sqm (PHDC) or TMG's landbank at post-devaluation market prices will print multiples of the price. The plan gives no construction (land at cost vs market, PV at what rate over what absorption horizon, no promotion test for a new primary lens) and no fallback when the sqm price cannot be sourced ("recorded as a gap" — then what is the central?). The one guard offered — "fair.bear/full is a PV envelope containing the central" — does not bind the LEVEL.
(4) WS6 internal contradiction: "at each origin, FV from the statement walk-forward's own MECHANICAL drivers (bottom_up.py)" but "the 2025 origin must reproduce each published central to 1e-6" — the published centrals use judgement drivers (TMGH 300bn, PHDC's own build). Both cannot hold. The record will grade the mechanical method (which loses to freeze on profit at h1 on 4/5) and attribute its error to rate/lens levers.

SYMMETRIC GUARDS PRESENT AND ADEQUATE: pre-registration hash before any number moves; grep for gap/price/spot in justifications; reverse-DCF static-import check; 'untested' label on class-B levels; assert_forward_inside_record symmetric (PHDC npat above p90 fails as TMGH below p10 does); the non-criterion "a name may finish 40% below price"; the two-sided negative control built either way. These are real. What is missing is the guard against SELECTION optimism inside WS6 and the guard against an unbounded new lens.

WHAT FOLLOWS. Four of the five gaps are manufactured by rules the house wrote and never wired to a script, by a blend that never cleared the promotion rule, and by Fisher incoherence; every one is enforceable by a script reading the delivered numbers and needs no walk-forward to remove. The programme's own arithmetic says the class-A stack pushes TMGH's capacity case ABOVE 97.80 (89.47 at the flat rate, then a glide worth +33-95%), so the eight-heading review runs BOTH WAYS inside this programme regardless of the standing gate's sidedness. What is genuinely open — Egypt's country premium level, the ERP basis, the terminal anchors, the reinvestment basis, minority basis, any blend — ships labelled 'untested' and enters only through a pre-registered valuation calibration that scores each fair value against the DRIFT-ADJUSTED realised return that followed, with an ordered lever sequence, a stop rule at zero bias and held-back confirmation origins, because under a pessimistic baseline every upward lever 'shrinks bias' and per-lever promotion is the CRPS-selection mistake in a new costume. Expected landings are PREDICTIONS, graded and never targeted; a name may finish 40% below price if its drivers face its record, its rate is the house schedule and the record shows no method bias.
principles: THREE CLASSES, WRITTEN INTO THE PROTOCOL: (A) compliance and identity fixes — enforcing a rule already adopted (SRP:302-348 glide, :327 CDS primary, :377 value-driver formula as written, :383-387 NCI at value, tier-2 relever, L-048/L-055 Fisher recomputation, L-062 grid-returns-base), removing a parameter that never cleared the promotion rule (typed lens weights), or asserting an arithmetic identity — ship first with a pre-registered revert condition; (B) level and design choices (terminal ERP norm, terminal real-rate convention, terminal inflation, glide length, ERP basis as a level, lambda, beta shrinkage, Dimson, terminal reinvestment basis nominal-vs-real, minority basis where disclosure cannot settle it, RNAV-vs-DCF as primary, any blend, correction strength) are FINITE candidate sets written from named external sources, ship at a default FROZEN in the day-1 pre-registration (equal to the committed AMOC/ARCC conventions where those exist) labelled 'untested', and enter only through the valuation calibration; (C) every A rule and every promoted B choice gets an outside script that fails, negative-controlled, anchored to a population counted elsewhere [R-ENF-01/04].

PRICE GRADES, PRICE NEVER FEEDS [R-LENS-01]: the reverse-DCF, the implied-Ke band, the contemporaneous agreement and the calibration score are diagnostics written to a separate diagnostics file (reverse_dcf.json / scores) that a static check proves no builder, four-field register or cost_of_capital.json reads; no parameter anywhere carries 'gap', 'price', 'spot', 'implied', 'realised' or 'reverse' as its justification; continuous minimisation of any price-distance is prohibited in the pre-registration text.

THE CALIBRATION SCORE CARRIES THE DRIFT OR IT GRADES THE WRONG THING: a value struck at t that is exactly right is expected to sit BELOW the price h years later by the cost of equity less distributions, so log(FV_t / P_{t+h}) with a zero-bias target would grade a correct method pessimistic by construction (at Ke 27-37% less a 5-10% yield, -0.15 to -0.30 log at h=1). The promotion score is gap-closure on FV rolled forward at the study's own (Ke - distributions), total return where dividends are sourced from the audited cash-flow statements and price-only labelled otherwise; contemporaneous agreement at h=0 is REPORTED as the answer to the principal's question and is never a promotion score.

PROMOTION IS ORDERED, STACKED, STOPPED AND CONFIRMED: levers are pre-registered in a fixed ORDER and evaluated sequentially on the current stack; a lever is retained only while the stacked pooled bias moves toward zero without crossing it by more than the bootstrap half-width; promotion STOPS once the stacked 90% CI contains zero; the last two origins per name are a CONFIRMATION sample used for nothing else; the candidate count is printed and a family-wise rule applied; a lever whose effect has the same sign on every name and era is a level shift and is never judged alone.

ACCEPTANCE IS ON GATES, PRE-REGISTRATION, PROMOTION DISCIPLINE AND GOVERNANCE — NEVER ON WHERE FAIR VALUE LANDS: every expected landing lives in PREDICTIONS_{date}.md, is graded after the fact, and appears in no criterion the programme is run against; a number that must not be tuned toward cannot be a stopping condition.

REVIEWS RUN BOTH WAYS INSIDE THIS PROGRAMME: any re-issue whose central sits more than 10% above OR below spot gets the dated review (nine headings, the ninth being DRIVERS ABOVE DISCLOSED CAPACITY) before it is finished, independent of the principal's answer on the standing gate's sidedness — the protocol decision governs the standing gate, the programme decision governs these re-issues.

A RULE ADOPTED ON THE PRINCIPAL'S INSTRUCTION IS AMENDED ONLY ON THE PRINCIPAL'S WORD: SRP:302-304 (prospective only, 13-Jul-2026) and SRP:377 (value-driver formula) are not reverted by a test; every calibration revert ruling is a RECOMMENDATION (retain / recommend revert / undetermined-at-n) recorded for the principal, and the class-A tier's reach over the ~27 live flat-rate EGX studies is a day-0 question, not an assumption.

STATEMENTS AND RATE MOVE IN ONE PASS ON EVERY NAME, WITH A CONVERGED HORIZON AND ONE MACRO PATH IN NUMERATOR AND DENOMINATOR; where a study's forward line sits inside its own record (PHDC's npat does) the statement leg is left alone and the rate/lens/bridge fixes carry the move.

THE PROMOTION RULE BINDS THE CALIBRATION TOO: the break-reset amendment and the strength constant are tested on held-out origins EXCLUDING the record that generated the hypothesis (TMGH), replicated on the next EGX campaign name before leaving PROVISIONAL, with strengths {0.25, 0.5, 1.0} reported never selected.

REMOVAL OF AN UNPROMOTED PARAMETER NEEDS NO TEST; RE-ADMISSION DOES; A NEW PRIMARY LENS IS A DESIGN CHOICE AND IS GRADED LIKE ONE: the typed blend goes now; RNAV becomes a class primary only where its inputs reach the finest sourced level, else the delivery-cycle DCF stays primary and RNAV is a labelled cross-check.

A GATE READS THE DELIVERED FILE AND WRITES ITS OWN RATCHET: answer.json is the single machine-readable output surface; an unreadable or stub answer FAILS; each ratchet list is written by its gate's first run in the same commit as the gate (never typed on day 0), prints its examined count against a population counted elsewhere, and may only shorten [R-ENF-02/04].

THE MINIMUM SHIPPABLE INCREMENT SHIPS FIRST: corrections already computed and reviewed in the repository (TMGH 89.47 at the unchanged rate; PHDC's latest balance sheet and NCI) are applied as an internal interim edition on days 1-2, labelled interim and superseded by the full re-issue, because leaving computed corrections unapplied for nine days is the C9 defect restated.

ONE TAXONOMY, ONE ID PER RULE, ONE NAME PER CONCEPT: the lens registry is keyed on lessons_register.CLASSES by import; the calibration directory does not end in '_walkforward' (three existing gates glob that suffix); [R-FCAL-02] and [R-GAP-02] are distinct rules, their parents amended in place under their own ids; rule text carries commands that read the live state, never the numbers.

CONTESTED JUDGEMENTS ARE PUBLISHED BOTH WAYS, NEVER AVERAGED, AND THE DIRECTION THEY RESOLVE IS COUNTED: every choice worth more than 5% of value is registered with both values and the adopted side, and a study resolving all such choices one way at p<0.05 is flagged by a script.

PUBLISHING TO testahil.com AND THE STANDING GATE'S SIDEDNESS STAY ON THE PRINCIPAL'S EXPLICIT WORD, asked on day 0 with the site's current state stated (TMGH shown +50% above price); the two-sided negative control is built either way.

workstreams.problem: No fair value has ever been graded against a later price: value_gap_backtest_EG_20260824 (n=32 one-month cells, IC -0.140, p=0.446, INSUFFICIENT-POWER) is the only instrument, and it fails by design on a shallow clone (value_gap_backtest.py:90-106). The prior draft's instrument had four defects the critics caught: (i) its directory name engine/valuation_walkforward/ ends in '_walkforward', which scripts/check_lessons_register.py:111-142, engine/fv_movement.py:239-241, engine/lessons_harvest.py:237 and campaign_queue.py:154 glob — the gate would derive ticker 'VALUATION' and FAIL — and lessons_register.ORIGINS has no valuation origin so its findings could not be registered; (ii) the score log(FV_t/P_{t+h}) with a zero-bias target ignores expected drift and grades a correct method pessimistic by construction; (iii) per-lever promotion 'bias shrinks on >= 3 of 4 names' is DIRECTIONALLY TAUTOLOGICAL under a baseline below price at every origin — every candidate lever raises value, so all pass until the stack overshoots, with no order, no stop rule, no confirmation sample and no multiplicity control; (iv) 'FV from mechanical drivers at every origin' and 'the 2025 origin reproduces each published central to 1e-6' cannot both hold because the published centrals use judgement drivers. Origin prices were undefined (no publication-date field exists: phdc ir_register carries 2022 CMS timestamps, tmgh carries period only, arcc has no ir_register). Data: statement panels PHDC 2008-25, TMGH 2011-25, EGCH FY2008-25 (main), ARCC 12 year-ends, AMOC LIGHT; 31 of 37 EG libraries with >= 10 December closes in the raw library (calendar-year count 33); NOT on disk: EGP rate history, Damodaran vintages, dividends, disclosure dates.

TWO SCORES: (a) contemporaneous agreement a_0 = log(FV_t / P_t) — REPORTED as the answer to the principal's question, never a promotion score; (b) drift-adjusted gap closure e_h = log(FV_t x prod(1 + ke_s - y_s) / P_{t+h}) for h = 1, 2, 3 where ke is the study's own cost of equity at the origin and y its distribution yield, TOTAL RETURN primary where dividends per share are sourced from the audited cash-flow statements under SIGCM, PRICE-ONLY labelled fallback otherwise; three naive benchmarks drift-adjusted identically (FV = P_t; own trailing-5y median P/E x EPS; own median P/B x BVPS); bias / MAE / share negative; moving-block bootstrap over origins {2,3,4} seed 42; split-half by era (pre/post 2016 float; pre/post 2022-24 devaluations); leave-one-name-out; EFFECTIVE INDEPENDENT n (about the origin count, ~10 per name) printed beside every cell count; the origin population counted as December closes >= 10 in the raw library with engine/data_quality.py applied before any price is read; the LEVER SET as FINITE candidate sets with external sources and frozen defaults (Fisher; Koller reinvestment nominal vs real; Damodaran beta-scaled vs lambda CRP, rating vs CDS; r2 glide vs flat and glide length; terminal ERP norm / real-rate / terminal inflation candidates; class lens vs equal-weight PV envelope vs published blend; RNAV vs DCF as primary; NEP E/Ke vs E/(Ke-g); minority book vs profit share vs value share; raw vs Blume vs Vasicek; Dimson vs OLS) in a FIXED ORDER; THE PROMOTION RULE: levers evaluated SEQUENTIALLY on the current stack; retain only while the stacked pooled drift-adjusted bias moves toward zero without crossing it by more than the bootstrap half-width; STOP once the stacked 90% CI contains zero; a lever whose sign is uniform across every name and era is a level shift judged on the stack only; the last TWO origins per name (FY2023, FY2024) are a CONFIRMATION sample used for nothing but confirming the promoted stack;
